abstract: One of the best induction motor challengers is switched reluctance motor. It is a popular option due to its sturdiness, simplicity, uncomplicated design and excellent torque to mass ratio. In switched reluctance motor, currents in stator winding directly impacts the torque produced. In order to cut off the current as fast as possible while it is working in demagnetizing mode, a high negative voltage must be provided. The design of the C-dump converter is discussed in this article. The C-Dump converter enables rapid demagnetization and magnetization of phase winding, which prohibits the motor from operating in generating state. To adjust speed, power, and operation, switched reluctance motors show a range of converter topologies. It also tends to make use of the accumulated energy in the phase winding, which can be provided back to the source. This stored energy can be used by some modified C-Dump converter topologies to escape the motor's next phase winding.

articleTitle: Sizing of Wind Turbine for Repowering of Old Wind Farm: A Case Study Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Large scale deployment of the Wind Power since early 1990's in India has hardly left any potential virgin windy land sites for the generation of power from wind energy. The sites wind high CUF are installed with the low rated power capacity wind turbines like 225 kW, 500 kW. The rapid increase in the technology in this sector has now forced to change these potential sites with the turbines having high capacity. The paper presents the overview of the wind power installation in India and the statistics of number of turbines in Maharashtra State. Also, it states the benefits of repowering in one the site in the state, by selecting the optimum size of turbine. In the repowering of wind farms the selection of appropriate size of the turbines is an important aspect to maximize the capacity utilization factor from the site. This paper explains the process of selecting the proper turbine size for repowering with the help of a flowchart and the mathematical modeling with the wind resource parameters.

articleTitle: Design a Robust Controller for BLDC speed control
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Brushless Direct Current (BLDC) motor is superior to carbon brushed DC motors, such as high efficiency, more speed range, less maintenance, longer life etc. This is because BLDC motor has electronic commutation and thus, does not have to overcome friction unlike the brushed DC motor. Thus, they find application in many areas such as Electric Vehicles and Robotics. However, a disadvantage of BLDC motor is that it requires a controller for electronic commutation which can be expensive and also increases the complexity of the implementation. The BLDC motors which are controlled by classical controllers suffer from problems of parametric variation during commutation and torque ripple in the output. The project aims to design a Robust controller for BLDC motor speed control so as to improve the output of BLDC motor.

Author Keywords: Disturbance Observer based Sliding Mode Control

articleTitle: AI in Entertainment – Movie Recommendation using cosine similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: This age of information brings in a huge amount of data and combined with the number of options available on the internet, it becomes a huge problem in choosing a single thing. This is an example of the saying finding a needle in the haystack. The solution for that is using a magnet to attract the needle, the magnet in this case is a good recommendation system. A recommendation system is a tool that can help a user find the best option for the wide variety of options available. Nowadays every application we use is controlled by a recommendation system. Many platforms like Amazon Prime, Voot, ZEE5, which suggest movies, Zomato which suggests food, Spotify, Wynk, Hungama Music which suggests music, Airbnb, Trivago which suggests hotels and policy bazaar which recommends policy. In this project, we used Cosine similarity for a movie recommendation. Cosine similarity is a distance calculation metric that will tell us the distance between two items if the cosine of the angle between them is small it means that the items are close to each other and vice versa.

articleTitle: KPSO: K-Mean and PSO based clustering algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Sensor networks are a wonderful tool for many applications, but saving energy in such networks is an important issue. Data aggregation between the sensor nodes can be overwhelming unless information flooding is in place. The sensor nodes clustering may provide a solution to this problem. To solve this problem, there must be the optimal distribution of sensors and CHs so that the network life span is improved while energy consumption is minimized. To progress the network performance of the WSNs, this paper discusses a hybrid clustering technique that relies on K-Means clustering and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). The evaluation of the proposed KPSO algorithm with traditional clustering techniques, such as Mod-LEACH and K-means clustering, has been done.

articleTitle: Glioblastoma Brain Tumor Segmentation and Survival Prediction Using U Net
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Magnetic resonance (MR) tissue isolation is a crucial step in providing specialised testing of glioma aggression and treatment response. Separating magnetic resonance (MR) tissue is an beneficial procdure in permitting precise testing of glioma aggression and treatment response. This method was used to break down the difficult task of separating multiple segments into discrete binary separation problems within each subdivision. Different tactics and losing challenges were used to prepare each group. After manual/semi-automatic tumour segmentation, the prediction of quantity imaging properties such as volumebased measures has reflect extra activity in the process of images base image-based tumour arrangement over privileage using clinical protocal such as immense anterior-posterior, transverse, and inferior-superior tumour extent on a subjectively chosen segment. Such phenotyping could improve surgical and therapeutic planning by allowing for the evaluation of reflected biological processes. The great variation of look and form of brain tumours, including sub-regions, makes segmentation problematic, which can be exacerbated by the process of enact errors such as movement and/or field inhomogeneity.

articleTitle: Correlation between Image and Text from Unstructured Data Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Information extraction (IE) is a technique for extracting structured data or knowledge from unstructured data by determining the references to words as well as the relationships between them. IE systems can be used to directly extract knowledge from a text corpus, or to extract useful data from a pile of documents which moreover, can be further analyzed with deep learning algorithms to discover more patterns. In today's era, the internet exhibits several characteristics including unstructured data and noisy text information. Unstructured data may contain audio, image, text, video, etc. Information extraction can be useful for topic detection (Twitter, Digital libraries), Breast Cancer detection and many more applications. The proposed system can exploit deep learning for information extraction using image as well as text and can significantly improve its performance with the inclusion of structured and unstructured data. This paper focuses on extraction of information from unstructured data using various deep learning models and concepts of Natural Language Processing (NLP), Long Short Term Networks (LSTM) and for topic extraction used Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) etc.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effects of Cyber Threats on NTP IST Dissemination Service and Measures for their Effective Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: NTP time dissemination is the most widely used time dissemination service throughout the world. However this service is the most susceptible to cyber-attacks. Denial of Service (DoS) attacks are the most common attacks observed on NTP service. DoS is typically accomplished by flooding the targeted server with unnecessary huge number of requests so that the service gets hampered. In this study we are analyzing four types of flood attacks on NTP service. These attacks are namely Ping flood attack, SYN flood attack, UDP flood attack and Ping of Death attack. The main aim of this study is to discuss the various Denial of Service attacks, their effects on the working IST dissemination service of CSIR-NPL via NTP and their effective mitigation.

articleTitle: Inventory and Attendance Management System for Construction Firm with Voice Assistant
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The goal of this paper is to provide an inventory management system used in the construction sector. With this approach, the Constructing firm's manual activities are turned into a computerized system. In firms where data is still maintained on paper, it minimizes paperwork and human mistakes. It will improve the overall performance of the system. In this paper, the proposed solution is a computerized inventory management application that can run on any mobile operating system. The system is being developed using an incremental methodology. We selected Google's Firebase for database development and deployment, which is designed to expand linearly with the size of the data being synced. To make the managing and editing process easier, we added Voice Assistant for the Application. A user can provide a command verbally, which is subsequently converted to text using Machine Learning and carried out after analysis. To convert speech to text, we used the react-native voice API. We utilized a string-matching algorithm to separate data after it was collected. We examined many string-matching algorithms and discovered that Jaro Winkler had the highest string-matching accuracy. We also utilized Kmeans clustering on database data to group them into clusters based on High, Medium, and Low Costs, so that site administrators may focus on those material alternatives to lower overall costs and increase profits.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Face Recognition System for Criminal Identification in Surveillance Video
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: With the enhancement of Technology related with video surveillance the security issue need to be handled more precisely. Face recognition system can be used to enhance the level of security in many applications as the people are the center of attraction in many cases such as criminal identification in surveillance, biometric face identification. However, there are significant challenges due to poor image resolution, improper lighting conditions, Illumination, face view and other aspects such as alignment of the face concerning the camera mainly for surveillance video. The proposed system is developed for identification of criminal faces stored in database from the surveillance camera placed in commercial places. The proposed system aims to compare and identify the efficient detection model based upon their accuracy, speed of operation, and reliability. The pre-processing techniques are used with face detection model that will result in identification of unaligned faces from surveillance video. The main purpose of preprocessing step is to make the detection step more faster and reducing false positive. The features extracted from the preprocessing techniques are used for training the dataset and applied to local binary pattern histogram for recognition of the faces from trained database.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: People nowadays are unable to acquire full rest and complete bedtime sleep due to our busy and chaotic society. As a result, when they drive after an interrupted sleep, especially at night, they end up nodding asleep, which can be extremely dangerous. Drowsy driving causes several accidents each year, and it frequently goes unnoticed, resulting in significant loss of life and resources. We're attempting to demonstrate a system that detects tiredness while driving and notifies the driver. These features are only available in high-end vehicles. The system we'll show you employs goggles with an infrared sensor mounted in front of the driver. The detection of closed or closed eyelids. Hence, we provide users with cheap and efficient technology. Finally, we identify the challenges faced by the current system and present a solution to it.

articleTitle: System to capture WiFi based Drones using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has emerged as one of the most vital technologies of the twenty-first century in recent years. IoT can be described as the common physical objects that are digitally connected. Things in IoT refers to all the physical objects like sensors that can be used to be embedded with software. A drone is a type of unmanned aerial vehicle. It does not have a human pilot on board, as the name implies. Because of its compact size and lightweight mechanism, it has a lot of potential to carry out tasks that will make our lives easier. Drones may be controlled via different mediums like wifi transmissions and radio frequency signals. In the case of radio frequency drones, the drones are typically controlled via a remote controller, although wifi equipped drones may also be controlled by devices with wifi access, such as smart phones. Due to the qualities of the drone, they have become popular for use in both legal and unlawful activities, such as delivering illegal materials across country borders. Anti-drone systems are thus being developed in anticipation of their potential use in future smart cities. However, the cost of each anti-drone technology is currently too exorbitant to be employed in civilian settings. As a result, we've offered a notion for creating an anti-drone system utilizing IoT technologies in this article. Making an anti-drone system with Raspberry Pi and Wifi-Pineapple is the subject of this study. Wireless assaults can knock down or even take control of wifi-enabled drones, forcing them to make a safe or emergency landing. In this paper we have tried to bring down the drone in the vicinity of the system by means of a wireless attack using the above components. The wireless attack consists of deauthentication attack and wireless password cracking. In this study, the findings and the attack success rate have been described. The DJI Tello, a WIFI-enabled drone, was the one used in this experiment, and the system was automated so that it could decide for itself how to carry out the attacks.

articleTitle: Event Trigger Based Realistic Performance of MIH for Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Wireless technology has become an indispensable part of people's daily life. As a subscriber to any wireless service, the user expects uninterrupted wireless data and phone services, maybe at a cheaper cost. Furthermore, customers anticipate an “always-on connection” from networks, i.e., they want services to be available everywhere and at any time, regardless of the service provider or underlying technology. However, because various wireless standards and technologies are emerging worldwide, handshaking or handoff (also known as vertical/intersystem/seamless handoff) between different standards is unavoidable to provide seamless services. MIP (Mobile Internet Protocol), Hierarchical MIP (HMIP), and Fast MIP (FMIP) are some of the options for handling flawless handover needs. Another unique solution is proposed in the IEEE 802.21 standard, MIH (Media Independent Handover). In this paper, we propose a realistic performance evaluation of MIH based on the link-layer event triggers like Link up, Link down, Link detected, etc., for optimized QoS parameters such as packet loss and handover delay. We consider realistic terminal speeds and application traffic for a defined scenario. The performance evaluation of MIH is carried out for two modern heterogeneous wireless networks, LTE/WiMAX and Wi-Fi.

articleTitle: Secure Wireless Sensor Network Design Using a New Method of High-Speed Lightweight Encryption
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Data streaming over a wireless network such as Wireless Sensor Networks, where wireless terminals (like PDAs, mobile phones, palmtops) access in data conferencing system, new challenges will be brought about. goal for this paper is to propose a high-speed lightweight encryption (HSLE) for low computational capability controller of WSN, HSLE scheme which reduces latency overhead by modifying existing approaches in order to encrypting data using a probabilistic encryption of data blocks. Proposed work is also useful when we communicate our confidential data on WSN or IoT it should be secure, we just have to save an encrypted data on cloud servers. proposed work is a new key-based algorithm and uses HSLE encryption instead for high end AES. Proposed methods cause significant speed enhancement for data encryption with similar security, in addition, it is best suited in order to communication between hand-held devices such as mobile phones, palmtops etc. algorithm may be used between sites where processing capacity and battery power are limited and efficient encryption is main necessity. This work is implemented on MATLAB and a wireless sensor network of maximum 100 nodes developed for testing the proposed network node encryption system, the time delay observed for the communication in 100 nodes WSN is less in compare with the other available works.

Author Keywords: PSNR: Peak Signal to Noise Ratio

articleTitle: Messenger Read Later Feature with Reminder Function
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: WhatsApp is a social media platform used for instant messaging and has over 2 billion users worldwide. It has audio and video calling, image sharing, notifications, etc. Notifications are very important, but their utility is significantly reduced when delivered at the wrong time. A person, in general, uses WhatsApp for an average of 38 mins per day. On an average a person is a member of at least 6 groups of more than 30 members. Many of these groups are important (Ex: Office group, Meeting group, Presentation group, etc.) and valuable messages are shared on these groups every day. Users find it difficult to segregate the crucial messages from the lesser important ones. The “Starred Messages” feature in WhatsApp is not designed in such a way that it can segregate the messages into various categories. Our idea of devising a “WhatsApp Read later Feature” is to make the segregation of messages quick, easy and comfortable so the users find and organize them quickly, increasing their productivity. The feature also comprises an inbuilt reminder function that gives users a reminder for the particular selected message, a wholly new and unique feature.

articleTitle: Tuning of Vehicle Features through CyberApps for Reducing on Vehicle Efforts
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Simulation Based Product Development (SBPD) is to simulate the Engine and Vehicle condition for calibration testing and performance simulation. Initially HIT bench platform were used for calibration and testing which requires actual hardware for checking implementation which will eventually leads to time consumption and if encounter any error then will affect directly to main hardware setup. To avoid this Vehicle Simulation can be performed first. Here this simulation is performed for heavy vehicle configurations like Truck. This project work provides methodology for tuning vehicle feature and overview of CyberTruck of which we are reducing the efforts by performing the simulation to save fuel, and correcting bad driver behavior through Cyber Apps which is to utilize virtual simulated environment. Also this paper covers integration of feature which controls engine speed as per some of the external conditions hence increase in Engine Life. This method will help to achieve time flexibility and repeatability. Also feature tuning will lead to monitor and achieve better Fuel Economy FE which is one of the important aspects in current situations.

articleTitle: Design of Low Cost Wearable Microstrip Patch Antenna for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Many women have breast cancer and can be fatal if not treated properly. The most crucial function for recognizing and impacting malignant tissue is diagnosis. The WBAN (Wireless Body Area Network) application helps monitor patient health and send data wirelessly. Portable antennas have the potential of supporting WBAN. Portable antennas make patient monitoring more convenient and consistent. The recommended operating frequency of the antenna is 2.4GHz. To build a portable antenna, we use jeans as the dielectric substrate for a microstrip antenna with a permittivity of 1.6. The rectangular microstrip patch antenna is powered by the transmission feed line. Metrics such as reflection attenuation (S11), gain and radiation pattern, and VSWR are examined to confirm the use of the antenna design.

articleTitle: Real-time weapon detection using Drone
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Drones or Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV's) are used widely because of their advantages like small size, low cost and portability. From past few years, drones have become important part in private as well as government sectors to reduce work load as well as to do work in less time. In agriculture field also drones are used to monitor crops, to supply water and to send live video of crops over network. Real-time object detection can play important role in security and surveillance. Drones can fly autonomously and it can capture live video. This video can be used for object detection. Proposed system captures live video frame using Raspberry pi camera module with help of drone. This video data is sent to real-time weapon detection system. If weapon is detected in video, then system give alert/notification on it, so operator can take appropriate action. Object detection module is created at computer side for fast object detection. OpenCV and YOLOv3 is used for weapon detection. Raspberry pi camera module work as a camera for computer. System has shown very good performance for detecting guns and rifle in stored as well as live streaming video.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Automatic Tripod Style Horizontal Multi Bobbin Wire Winder
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Winding machines are generally utilized in the wire drawing manufacturing line. A solitary bobbin winder that is utilized presently in the business has certain disadvantages connected with production like time utilization for supplanting bobbins, harm to wire material because of the utilization of improper wire cutting strategy or instruments, and additional work for following through with the responsibility of supplanting bobbins. We broke down various kinds of Wire winding machines at present utilized in Industries and arrived at the decision of fostering a Multi bobbin wire winder to conquer the issues looked by the maker. We have fostered a Tripod style flat Multi bobbin winder which is worked utilizing different motor regulators or PLC and a basic electronic controlled system to wind the wire around every bobbin at the underlying phase of winding. The Winding, replacing of bobbin, entanglement and clamping of wire on bobbin is done automatically. The motivation behind this improvement was to improve the production rate and accuracy while utilizing less labor and time.

articleTitle: Generic, Stand-Alone IoT Solution for Cloud Connectivity in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The past decade has witnessed tremendous advancements in the field of electric vehicle, which in turn has resulted in the need for cloud connectivity in vehicles due to the numerous advantages provided by it like aid in autonomous driving, connected cars and real-time fault notifications. Currently, incorporation of Internet of Things into automobiles is in its relative early stage and new solutions are coming up every day for connecting automobiles to the cloud. This paper presents a generic and scalable solution for incorporating IoT to establish cloud connectivity in real-time, within the dynamic environment of an automobile. A hardware prototype, which is a plug-and-play type IoT device, is developed which is comparatively 63% cheaper as compared to the existing models that are currently available in the market. The device can carry out data collection and logging for up-to 2 CAN buses, with data transmission to a cloud server made possible with the help of a GSM module, thus eliminating the need for Wi-Fi or ethernet and making the device a truly stand-alone system.

articleTitle: FRNDY: A Women's Safety App
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Women's security has always been a major concern, and numerous potential solutions have been discussed regarding how technology can be used to address the issue. Currently, the rapid rise in smartphone usage has made it possible to integrate personal security efficiently and effectively with the help of hardware and software. Existing security methods necessitate some form of human input and the use of only pre-selected contacts. When it comes to tragic occurrences involving women, the number is frighteningly high. Problems can arise from a variety of situations, including women walking on the street after work, going to the supermarket, or a variety of other reasons when they are alone. There has been a spike in women-related crimes in Malaysia as well. Therefore, to enhance women's safety in Malaysia this project suggests a mobile application that can come in handy for women who find themselves in dangerous situations. When the need arises, a single click on this application will recognize the location using GPS and will send a message to the registered contacts containing the location URL, as well as call the first registered contact to assist the user in a difficult situation. Authentication of their identity is also mandatory for this application. The primary goal of this study is to ensure and enhance personal safety. As a result, the primary goal of this project is to make it easier for users to get assistance promptly. In addition, a security pin is used as the login password to verify the user's identity and prevent an anonymous or malicious attack. This project makes use of the agile methodology to make certain that testing is carried out in each module. It creates opportunities to reevaluate the development lifecycle to make sure the entire project fulfills the outcome and operates well. After several iterations of refinement and debugging, the final system is deemed bug-free.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach: Rough Set, Artificial Neural Networking & Data Envelopment Analysis on patient's satisfaction in healthcare organization
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Data mining plays a significant role in information acquisition and effective information utilisation from big data. Many techniques are available for data mining, In many disciplines, including health care services, data reduction using rough set theory is a commonly utilized mathematical technique. In this paper, Rough Set Theory (RST) is applied to a patient's satisfaction survey to identify sets of critical attributes which are responsible for the patient's satisfaction. RST is a useful tool for data mining, however the data it extracts lacks efficiency and precision. This study proposes a novel approach to tackle this problem, combining Rough Set Theory, Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is the leading approach used to find the dependency of output variables on input variables. These powerful instruments Through the use of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) results, RST and DEA are utilised to determine the effectiveness of reductions. Based on cross-validation of ANN accuracy of forecasting is determined. Maximizing patient satisfaction is an important goal of Health care organizations. Patients' feedback helps them to identify the ways to improve their working methods which transforms into better care and happier patients. In this paper, Rough Set Theory is applied to a patient's satisfaction survey to identify sets of critical attributes which are responsible for the patient's satisfaction. DEA & ANN give the best set of critical attributes based on their efficiency.

articleTitle: Application of GA Technique to Optimize the Performance of NTP Server
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: CSIR-NPL serves the nation as India's timekeeper. It has the responsibility to maintain and disseminate IST via various techniques. CSIR NPL is disseminating IST to the masses via NTP service with accuracy of few milliseconds. It is quite impressing to have a nationwide service with such a good synchronization offset. However, recently an experiment was undertaken to evaluate the performance of this service with geographically diversified, worlds leading NTP servers like Google, Facebook etc. It was observed that the offset of NTP service at CSIR-NPL is considerably more than that of other servers. In this paper a Genetic Algorithm (GA) based method is proposed to optimize the offset of NTP service.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lossless Data Compression Algorithm in Columnar Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Organizations are heading towards a modernization journey. Cloud providers are playing a vital role in this journey. The industry is focused on cost efficiency and ROI since they need a huge investment for the modernization journey. Also, there are overheads for maintaining the legacy systems until they are completely migrated. This puts a lot of focus on cost reduction and is influenced by storage, compression, and performance parameters, which influence the cost directly. In this paper, we focus on studying data compression patterns, specifically BROTLI and ZSTD for columnar databases. We demonstrate structured and unstructured compressed data loading, storage and query execution statistics. For future development, this paper provides insight for further research areas.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning based Responsive Web Platform for Cervical Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Classifying the cervical cells in the Pap smear images is a challenging problem. Many problems are associated with the complexity of the cell and contents that need to be identified. We attempt to make use of Deep Learning models to overcome the need of manual segmentation and feature extraction to finally predict if the given Pap Smear image shows signs of cancer or not. This system aims to aid the health care workers like doctors and pathologists in speeding up the process. In order to help maximize the comfort of the patient, we have developed a completely responsive web-based platform which is aided by our robust machine learning models to help the patient get their reports from the comfort of their homes and make it easier for early detection of cervical cancer.

articleTitle: Compact D Flip Flop in Quantum Dot Cellular Automata for Digital System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: At present, solution to Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor technology is one of the efficient nanotechnology device Quantum Dot Cellular Automata. QCA works on the principle of columbic repulsion without transistor usage. In this research efficient and compact D flip flop is proposed. The design uses an efficient 2:1 multiplexer to achieve improved parameters in terms of total area, the number of cells, energy dissipation and delay. The proposed D flip flop shows 54% improvement compared with the existing design in the number of cells, less delay of just 0.25 clock phase with 7.05e-003 eV of total energy dissipation and 6.41e-004 eV of average energy dissipation. The layouts are designed and the result is verified in QCA Designer 2.0.3 and QCA Designer E tool.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Solar Power Plant Using Exploratory Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: This study enhances the current monitoring and maintenance system of a solar power plant in a rural area in Sabah, Malaysia by performing data analytics and data visualizations on the collected data. The specific objectives of this project are to investigate the parameters of the solar power plant monitoring system, to conduct exploratory data analysis on the collected data by developing data visualizations, and to integrate the developed data visualizations into dashboards. The methodology used in the development of this project is Agile, and the final outcome are dashboards developed using Power BI. Based on the exploratory data analysis, faulty or underperforming inverters were detected, and factors affecting the daily yield were identified.

articleTitle: Analysis of bio inspired Optimization Algorithms: ABC, FA and ABO based on the Travelling Salesman's
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Engineering problems are becoming more and more complicated to solve as entire world is moving towards the industrialization. Increasing number of variables, dimensions and complex time and space made it more difficult to solve such problems. Similar to such problems nature is also complex, however insects, birds and animal survive in this intricate surrounding with the help of their unique qualities. Various insects or groups of animals seen in nature, such as ant colonies, bird flocks, bee swarms, and behavior of fish, could be used to address real-world problems. These solutions are called bio inspired optimization algorithm. This study focus on three mostly used bio inspired optimization algorithms artificial bee colony(ABC), firefly(FA) and African buffalo algorithm(ABO). In this study we have analyzed the results obtained by solving the travelling salesman problem using ABC, FA, and ABO algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of 340kW Grid Interactive Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic System for Paddy Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Solar photovoltaic system is one of the promising sources of energy with negligible emission. It is one among the most important renewable energy sources that determines a country's growth. Solar PV has a low maintenance cost, and a long lifespan, making it a popular alternative source of sustainable energy. Harnessing renewable energy to power a part of the load is one of the key ways in reducing the cost involved with energy consumption by the industries. In this work, an attempt is made to design the rooftop solar PV system to reduce the cost related to energy that is consumed by the industry. From the simulation studies it is found that the proposed system can generate an average of 44,119.08kWh energy per year. It is observed that there is an excess of 28.34% generation which is fed to the grid.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Different Models for Language Translation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: As India is country with diverse culture, there are 22 official languages and many other regional languages. Because of this, it is difficult for people to exchange the ideas and communicate with each other. In Neural Machine Translation (NMT), one language is translated to other which helps to overcome the barrier of language difference. In this paper, we have studied NMT Models to translate English sentences to Marathi. The neural machine translation models on the basis of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) are implemented respectively considering the differences in the structure of their networks. Transformer is also implemented after we discover the limitations of the above three basic models which are Long Term Dependency of Words, Exploding Gradient and Vanishing Gradient problem. Common steps followed in all models are Preprocessing, encoding and decoding. After studying all the models, a comparative analysis of models is done based on the Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score where we calculated Unigram(1-gram) and Bigram(2-gram) scores using reference and translated sentences.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Based Spectral Efficiency Analysis with Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: A special form of multicarrier modulation (MCM) with widely spaced subcarriers and overlapping spectra called Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) was patented in the US in the 1970s. Modern OFDM is widely used due to its spectral efficiency and robustness to noise and fading. Cognitive radios can benefit from its flexibility and agile frequency allocation. In this paper, we examine the use of OFDM and simulation to improve spectral efficiency. Because OFDM is immune to inter symbol interference (ISI) despite its high speed, it is ideal for high-speed wireless communications. Nowadays, communication systems have increased the speed of data transmission, which has shortened transmission times. In the presence of a constant delay due to multipath transmission, ISI has become a blocking factor in high data rate communications.

articleTitle: Online Voting System using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The crucial right to cast a vote or essentially casting a vote on a ballot forms the basis of democracy. From ballot boxes, to punch cards the voting systems are periodically transformed into EVMs for conducting elections. But, the existing e-voting systems are vulnerable to hacking, have limitations and risk of computer technologies, and needs physical security of machines as well. So, the main focus of the proposed system is to overcome these issues and introduce secure, user-friendly Online Voting. The proposed model enhances the level of security by making use of blockchain in which it is not possible to manipulate votes. Blockchain is used for storing votes and it gives sufficient security which minimize the chances of dummy votes. Cryptography and Face ID are also adopted for verification purposes. The presented online portal is highly secure and also has other unique security features such as primary id generation that puts another layer of security and enables the admin the ability to check the user information and to decide whether he is qualified to vote or not.

articleTitle: Electronic Differential Using the Concept of Torque Vectoring
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: For the two-wheel rear-wheel independently driven Electric Vehicle, the Electronic Differential System (EDS) or Electronic DS is used for Electric Vehicle (EV)or Solar Electric Vehicle (SEV) Which is modelled and simulated in this study. Due to several disadvantages of conventional mechanical differential drivetrains, being large and girthy systems that are inconvenient for EVs and SEVs, and mechanical losses produced by the powertrains, the electronic differential is being employed in a variety of EVs and SEVs. Equations developed from Ackermann Geometry using the Solidworks Software Package are used to determine front wheel speeds. The EDS simulation is then realized and customized using MATLAB. Considering the change in the magnitude of speed of the vehicle and tilt of steering wheel of EV or SEV, Rear in wheel-motor speeds estimated by Simulink model is verified by conducting prototypes. [3]

articleTitle: IOT Based Landslide Detection in Hilly Area
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: As per the records more than 5000 people are buried alive and there are more than 4 billion USD in losses every year due to landslide disasters globally. In India, the problem is quite severe, as India happens to be the landslide capital of the world where on average about thousand people lose their life every year on account of landslides. The problem with the landslide sensing technologies existing is that these technologies are costly technologies like conventional geotechnical monitoring. Thus, this article presents the early landslide detection based on various parameters of the hilly area such as moisture, rain level, vibrations and accelerometer sensor outputs. The proposed system provides an alert buzzer to the proximity using Fuzzy logic Controller. The anticipated scheme is implemented for the real time scenario and data is stored on the cloud for the future reference. It provides a simple, feasible and low-cost landslide monitoring and warning system.

articleTitle: Dysphonic Speech Reconstruction Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The speech disordered persons will be in the position to produce hoarse speech. In this paper we focused to convert and reconstruct the hoarse speech to a normal speech by using mel frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC). The extracted features are used to train cascaded Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). The necessary speech data for the work is collected from speech impaired subjects.

articleTitle: Heuristic approaches for an efficient cloud service management: Study and Analyze
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: In recent times, cloud computing has been a popular enterprise for holding as well as offering solutions, as it has grown up with great appeal in providing various solutions such as storage space and cloud holding. Aim of this paper is to study and deeply analyze the state of art in heuristic way to efficient use of cloud services. Analyze and demonstration of infrastructure building is done using kubernetes architecture. The overall performance is compared with traditional process and analyze results. Furthermore, the cloud deals with an effective computing platform that makes it possible for lots of individuals and also organizations to accomplish tasks such as: uses of on-line storage space, approval on business applications, creating custom computer software program, as well as easy developing an online network infrastructure. On the other hand, information troubles of cloud solutions are likewise increasing every year, as a result of hackers who are frequently trying to exploit safety and security holes in the cloud architecture. So the safety and security problems in these systems are terrible due to the fact that they save a great deal of exclusive as well as private information. Along with this, efficient uses of cloud is more challenging. This paper also helps to researchers in cloud computing domain to set new research objectives.

articleTitle: Prototype of Covid Tracer Management Application
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: As the world battles against the COVID-19 pandemic, a significant part of the world is trying to ease lockdowns while rapidly identifying individuals who may have been infected. Yet, such contact tracing is commonly a relentless and slow cycle that depends on face-to-face meetings, which is also dangerous. The government has come up with a contact tracing application, but such solutions are deemed by the public as too intrusive and non-beneficial, especially when it is obvious that this pandemic will be with us for a long time. As such, by integrating a reward-based approach to contact tracing, it would increase the level of awareness and interest in actively using such solutions among the public. The aim of this application is to increase the number of users using the contact tracing application. The usage of this mobile application would be beneficial to the users, which would increase the number of users of this application. The function of a contact tracing application would be more effective with the presence of a rewards system as more people would use the application to check-in at the places they go. The system is developed using Android Studio and uses Google Firebase as the database.

articleTitle: Detection of Fault in a PV Array using Teager Kaiser Energy Operator
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: When the fault current exceeds its rated value as specified by numerous international standards, the conventional Photovoltaic (PV) array protection devices are helpful in detecting Line-Line (LL) and Line-Ground (LG) faults. However, it is seen that the fault current in a PV string remains below its threshold value depending on the irradiance and position of the fault. As a result, a PV array occasionally has problems that go unnoticed. An undetected fault like this manifests in reduction in array power, damages the affected PV module(s) and leads to fire hazards. Available fault detection techniques have limitations in detecting faults in a PV array i) which are connected with blocking diode ii) during partial shading. In this study, we offer a Teager Kaiser Energy Operator (TKEO) based method that is less computationally intensive than previous approaches for fault identification in a PV array. The accuracy of the suggested strategy is practically tested on a number of common case studies.

articleTitle: Performance Implications of Thread Count on OS Level Factors in Multithreaded Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: In high-performance computing, picking the right number of threads to gain a good speedup is important, as many OS-level parameters are influenced by even slight adjustments in thread count. These parameters are required by the operating system for process management and should not be ignored. They also contribute overhead to the running program, which can mount up quickly if not properly managed. Using too many threads in the system raises overheads, but using too few threads in the system significantly reduces performance. In this paper, the impact of page faults, CPU migrations, CPU utilisation, and context switching on execution time is investigated. The proposed work is simulated on a dual-socket Intel Xeon E5-2603 v3 using the well-known benchmark PARSEC 3.0. After studying performance parameters, simulation results reveal that running multithreaded programs with a correct number of threads can result in greater speedup and save overall system time.

articleTitle: Predicting Terror Attacks Using Neo4j Sandbox and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Terrorism, and radicalization are major economic, political, and social issues faced by the world in today's era. The challenges that governments and citizens face in combating terrorism are growing by the day. Artificial intelligence, including machine learning and deep learning, has shown promising results in predicting terrorist attacks. In this paper, we attempted to build a machine learning model to predict terror activities using a global terrorism database in both relational and graphical forms. Using the Neo4j Sandbox, you can create a graph database from a relational database. We used the node2vec algorithm from Neo4j Sandbox's graph data science library to convert the high-dimensional graph to a low-dimensional vector form. In order to predict terror activities, seven machine learning models were used, and the performance parameters that were calculated were accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. According to our findings, the Logistic Regression model was the best performing model which was able to classify the dataset with an accuracy of 0.90, recall of 0.94 precision of 0.93, and an F1 score of 0.93.

articleTitle: Implementation of PID Based Automatic Temperature Control System using STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Using the Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) control method and the STM32 microcontroller unit, a quick and high-accuracy temperature control system was built (MCU). The temperature control system can be used in fields that have high demands for temperature control response speed and precision. A heating element is used for heating the water and the thermocouple sensor is responsible for sensing the water temperature. If the temperature goes higher than the setpoint value then a cooling system is designed to bring the temperature down. Thus, a constant temperature of the water is maintained using PID. We compare the required value to the present value using the microcontroller, and the result is shown on the LCD. In addition, to maintain a consistent temperature, the Fan or Heater is turned on or off in response to temperature deviations from the desired setpoint. Thus, the maintenance of a constant temperature by turning the relay on and off for heating or cooling elements is completely automated due to the PID algorithm set in the STM32 controller.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Circuit Level Leakage Reduction Approaches for 6T SRAM Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The suggested architecture's major goal is to improve stability and minimize leakage current by using various approaches on a 6T SRAM cell to reduce leakage power without compromising performance. Data in static random access memory (SRAM) does not need to be refreshed on a regular basis since it is not written permanently. Many techniques to SRAM cells have been developed to limit power consumption without compromising performance. This research proposes a 6T SRAM with three modes of operation (read, write or hold operation). The suggested design's main goal is to improve stability and latency in active mode, lower leakage current in standby mode, and keep the logic state in park mode.

articleTitle: Analysis of Employee Surveillance System using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Achieving maximum productivity becomes difficult in the conditions when the corporate working arrangements change from office to home. Any type ofinattentiveness can cause companies to incur huge financial losses. So in order to increase work efficiency and lessen the errors and risks in work, there comes a need for a system that monitors an employee's performance. This research paper titled “Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Employee Surveillance System” proposes an idea that will help corporate employers to solve this issue by providing a system that has a feature of monitoring attentiveness of their remote employees. This system is developed using OpenCV for real-time video capturing and deep-learning algorithm CNN for image classification and haar-cascade for cascading. CNN algorithm has been used in order to classify 3000 images of various eye states in a more proficient manner than traditional ones. It alerts the employee by an alarm which starts triggering after a certain threshold and it also starts recording a video by the same camera which will act as an evidence of the employee's negligence to his work. In addition, an internet checker has been installed, which allows it to analyze the internet connectivity of employee machines. Additionally, a SMS API has been used to notify the company/employer of the status of inactivity of the user/employee using a message or notification. A variety of models are being tested to determine the accuracy of the system. The conclusion of analysis work has been derived in order to come up with a more efficient system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Solar Photovoltaic Powered Neutral Point Clamped Single Phase and Three Phase Five Level Inverters
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Multilevel inverter (MLI) has several benefits over the conventional two-level inverter bridge like lower voltage stresses across the switches, lower harmonics, near to sinusoidal output and improved efficiency. These benefits enable inverter design to use a lower rating of devices thus reducing the cost of the inverter even though the number of devices increases. This paper compares the performance of single-phase and three-phase neutral point clamped (NPC) inverters up to a five-level configuration with solar power as input. The inverters are designed to measure their total voltage and current harmonics, voltage stress across each switch and efficiency of the inverters using MATLAB Simulink. Moreover, both square wave and sinusoidal pulse width modulation (PWM) methods are applied on both pure resistive (R) and resistive-inductive (RL) loads for a detailed comparative analysis of the inverters. The simulation results suggest that the sinusoidal PWM method for all types of inverters gives better performance in terms of reduction in harmonics however with increased burden of computation. This paper suggests a five-level NPC inverter for most solar power applications due to its superior performance.

articleTitle: Covi-Gate: Face Mask and Temperature Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: This paper projects machine learning as a valuable tool for the restriction of the Covid-19 pandemic escalation in the global scenario. The proposed system involves detection of masked or unmasked people and a temperature sensing system for ensuring Covid-19 appropriate protocol is followed to allow only healthy person(s) in public/crowded places. The integration of Arduino Uno and MLX90614 non-contact temperature sensor, along with a MobileNetV2 machine learning model, is performed for complete execution. The system will classify a person as a masked or unmasked individual using ML techniques and detect their body temperature. If the individual meets the appropriate requirements, the system will enable them to access via the gate, which will be controlled by a servo motor in conjunction with a temperature sensor module.

articleTitle: Park-Shield: Two-Wheeler Anti-Theft System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: In India the number of two-wheelers is greater than the cardinal number of parking spots available, hence people tend to park their vehicles at undesignated spots and open spaces which increases the risk of damage to the vehicle. To prevail over this situation, we contemplated, designed, and came up with a solution. Park Shield predominantly aims towards providing an all-inclusive system for two-wheeler vehicles that notifies the attempts of theft and live location tracking for your vehicle with absolute authentication of the users. The uniqueness of the system is that it can be controlled using an android application with authorized users registered on the database. In case the vehicle is hoisted or hauled, the live location update with an alert notification will be sent to the owner's cellular device via the application.

articleTitle: Mining Social Media Data Streams for Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Stream mining is the technique of collecting knowledge or patterns from continuously changing data streams. Data streams, unlike standard data sets, are collections of data instances that flow in and out of a system at different rates. They are organized in time, constantly changing, vast, and potentially limitless.

articleTitle: Anti Horn System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Excessive Honking is a major concern in countries like India. While in western countries, honking is considered a sign of insult or disrespect of the other driver, in countries like India, honking is a result of undisciplined traffic and disobeying traffic rules on a large scale. No Honking Zones are highly affected by this needless honking. Several technologies have been implemented in order to avoid excessive honking, but to no avail. Hefty fines are charged to control Noise Pollution caused due to honking, but a permanent solution to this is the need of the hour. This paper proposes an Anti Horn System to provide a solution to this problem faced worldwide. The proposed system aims at reducing the noise pollution drastically in No Honking Zones, like schools, hospitals and libraries to make cities smarter. The paper also throws some light on the commercialization aspect and feasibility of the proposed system

articleTitle: Two-Wheeler Location Tracking and Tilt Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Population in India is increasing rapidly which in turn there is an increase in the demand for public transport. Due to this increasingly high demand, most of the Indian population are looking for a better transportation experience along with less commuting time. One such alternative is private transportation for short-distance commutes. The statistics of the deaths caused by road accidents state that there are around 1 million deaths per year because of rash driving, steep turning, carelessness of driver etc. The proposed model of the embedded system will detect the latitude and longitudinal location of the accident spot using GPS and GSM module and sends the data to the WEB APIs when there is the availability of the network. Data acquisition is made in the absence of the network and data is stored in the local storage and retained when there is the availability of the network. A gyroscope is attached to the embedded system which provides the data about the total amount of bent done by the vehicle during the turn which in turn helps to identify the bike damage.

articleTitle: Automated Drinking Water Supply Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Water is an essential part of our life and its high time to implement good water conservation ideas. In cities, drinking water is supplied by Municipal corporation for 1-2 hours in a day at a given scheduled time. It is not possible for many to be available at the exact time to store the drinking water, especially those who are working people. Usually, they keep the tap open to fill the water container which sometimes leads to wastage of drinking water. This project focuses on development of an android application that enables users to set the water limit and the water supply timings. With the help of a designed system, it is possible to dispense only the required amount of water hence serving the purpose of drinking water conservation. This system enables users to visualise the live status of water filled in the container.

articleTitle: Electronic Health Record Management using Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: In these modern times, receiving health care services from various hospitals and clinics has become very common due to the predominant increase in the specialization of health care services and also as a consequence of people's moving to different cities and countries. Doctors who have a thorough understanding of a patient's medical history can more accurately make a diagnosis and provide treatment for the patient in the right timeframe. Despite improved medical services, healthcare service providers face issues in sharing sensitive data. The major problem faced by healthcare service providers right now is ensuring data security, data integrity, and confidentiality of the data while keeping the privacy of patients intact simultaneously. To solve this problem, we propose a blockchain technology using Hyperledger Fabric that allows patients to control their medical information and access doctors for data. By creating a distributed database of the patient's medical records, the patient can switch hospitals without bothering about the medical records. It also makes it easier for a doctor to keep track of a patient's medical history.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Based Open Switch Fault Diagnosis of Three Phase Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The fault diagnosis and subsequent remedial actions require human interleaving at every step. In a number of circumstances, the chance of a fault occurring is imprecise and incompletely specified. During condition-based monitoring, the maintenance engineer must use intelligence to make realistic decisions based on a large amount of data. On one hand, fault diagnosis problems are based on information, while on the other, they are based on rules. This is a challenging opportunity to apply Fuzzy Logic theory and concepts to the fault diagnostic process. The methodologies to defect diagnostic systems based on Wavelet Transform and Fuzzy Logic are presented in this study.

articleTitle: Conversion of Indian Sign Language to Speech by Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Sign language is the most used non-verbal communication method. It is mostly used by persons who have hearing and speaking disabilities. In this world, normal people find it difficult to interpret sign language, so it is very difficult to communicate with mute and deaf people. Mute and deaf people aren't able to express their thoughts to the world. To interpret the meaning of sign language an interpreter is needed. To eliminate the need of an interpreter a system is proposed using neural network. The proposed system can easily interpret the meaning of human hand sign to convert it into relevant speech. Our system has been implemented by using a deep learning technique, Convolution Neural Network (CNN). The hand images are pre-processed using canny edge detection technique for better accuracy. After pre-processing, the classification and prediction steps are applied. The speech synthesizer is used to convert text into speech using Google text to speech API. The proposed system achieves accuracy of up to 98%.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of ANN Using Customized Instruction Set for 1-D Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: This work describes the implementation of hardware architecture based on ANN and its hardware realization using hardware description language (Verilog) on FPGA. The objective of this project is “FPGA implementation of ANN using customized Instruction set for 1-D signal processing”. Our aim in this project is on designing small in size and functional processor architecture. The proposed project presents architectural design and execution of artificial neural network processor with a customized instruction set processor for 1 D signal processing. The ANN processor architecture is flexible, supporting random counts of layers and a number of 784 artificial neurons (ANs), The proposed architecture will support the feed-forward algorithm. The proposed architecture is flexible with the counts of input data; output data and signals will represent the fixed-point format and will compare the accuracies of the Tanh function and sigmoid function.

articleTitle: Analysis of Face Recognition Based Automated Attendance Management System Using FaceNet
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: This paper gives an analysis and study of the different face recognition algorithms that is used in our application i.e Automated attendance based automated attendance system. Human faces consist of complex multidimensional structures that can convey information like expression, facial features, feelings etc. Identifying a human face can be an easy task for a human being even if the person is seen after many years. But performing the same task by a machine (computer) is difficult because if there is change in certain conditions such as lighting conditions, sophisticated background, different pose and illusion, image taken from different angles etc, then the computer finds it difficult to identify the person. Identifying human faces by computer accurately i.e Face recognition is still an emerging field and research is going on.

articleTitle: Survey of Technologies for Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Technology is advancing day by day and with its relentless progress, the industry is also constantly evolving to meet new-age customer expectations with higher efficiency and sustainability. Automation and robots existed during industry 3.0 as well but now they are being connected in networks for the ease of managing, monitoring and controlling the manufacturing plants. Online / remote location based control and machine to machine communications are but few of the infinite possibilities opened up in the fourth industrial revolution. Industry 4.0 doesn't refer to a single technology/process, rather it is a seamless physical-digital integration of multiple cutting edge technologies. This paper presents a short survey covering important industry 4.0 technologies such as autonomous mobile robots (AMR), internet of robotic things (IoRT), block chain, artificial intelligence (AI), cyber security, big data analytics and machine learning (ML). This paper also presents important research scopes and directions identified for each of these technologies towards wider implementations of industry 4.0 architectures.

articleTitle: Model Based Design in Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Model based design (MBD) is a systems engineering approach wherein multi-dimensional models are designed to simulate, analyze and test actual systems. It is a mathematical and intuitive methodology that helps to solve complex problems related to design, communication, signal processing, control systems, software development and more. It is used to model embedded systems in industrial equipment, motion control in autonomous systems, aerospace navigation and automotive, medical systems among many more. MBD is a process that enables rapid and more financially viable development of multi-modal frameworks, including control, signal management, and embedded architectures. In model-driven planning, the framework model is at the heart of progressive interaction by improving compliance to the prerequisites of planning, execution, and testing. The current study presents a brief outlook of the important features, benefits, applications and implementation practices of MBD.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Trusted Secure Philanthropy Platform: Crypto-GoCharity
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Blockchain is one of the significant innovations and a disruptive technology. It is becoming a primary choice for solving many problems in the field of data security. Blockchain technology is also gaining popularity in the domain of crowdfunding and philanthropy. The paper describes the flaws in the charitable giving ecosystem and how blockchain can be used to address these issues through the use of blockchain building blocks such as distributed ledger technology, smart contracts, and cryptography. Through distributed ledger technology, the entire ledger copy is shared with all nodes in the blockchain, bringing transparency to the charity ecosystem. The immutability of the ledger transaction records ensures tamper resistance and fosters trust in the ecosystem. Cryptography also makes transactions more secure. The study aims to address the issue of charity donation monitoring in the philanthropic sector by removing the middleman and employing crypto-currency. This paper proposes philanthropy services through cryptocurrency via a web-based platform. The proposed system is a decentralized system which is built on Ethereum Blockchain using Solidity Smart Contract, which will provide complete transparency and donors will be able to track their donations. This paper proposes philanthropy services through cryptocurrency via a web-based platform.

articleTitle: Using Drone Technology for Fruit Orchard Management and Waste Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Developments in scaling down the size of sensors are expanding the worldwide fame of robotic distant tracking use cases in numerous areas of farming. Fruit plantations require area dependent or sometimes even single tree dependent administration all through the developing season-right from flowering phase, growth of fruitlet, maturing, and latency of reap to tree. New expansion in study of sending drones in plantation execution has given rise to new experiences however difficulties connecting with deciding the ideal methodology are hampering wide-spread reception, to a great extent since there is no standard workflow for the use of drones in plantation execution. This research paper gives a thorough writing audit zeroed in on UAV-based plantation administration: the study incorporates accomplishments to date and weaknesses to overcome. Detecting framework zeroing in on drones and sensing devices is summed up. Modern use cases upheld by drones in plantation administration are depicted, zeroing in on the variety of information handling methods, including tracking efficiency and preciseness. Determined to distinguish the limitations and inspecting the open doors for drone-based plantation managing, this research talks about the exhibition of arising advancements and analyses comparative exploration offering specialized and extensive help for the further use of drones and an upheaval in plantation administration.

articleTitle: Smart Low Cost Fruit Picker for Indian Farmers
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Fruit harvesting is the most crucial task which requires accuracy, experience and right judgment. It directly impacts profit or loss of the farmers. Early harvesting or very late harvesting may cause severe losses to the farmer's income. Harvesting of fruit depends on many parameters like color, shape, firmness, day time, market need, market distance, availability of labours' and transport facilities. More than 70% percent of farmers in India are poor and cannot afford high end machineries or technologies for the fruit harvesting. Low-cost fruit pickers are available in the Indian local market to ease the jobs which are better than manual hand-picking but they do not address the problem of accuracy or right decision whether the fruit is harvestable. This work proposes a low cost; IoT based smart system which can be integrated on any fruit picker easily. The proposed system helps farmers as the decision support tool in fruit harvesting. To detect the fruit on tree and to decide whether fruit is harvestable three state-of-art pretrained image classification models InceptionV3, ResNet50, and MobileNet with transfer learning were used. The model was trained on 400 images collected form internet. The results show that ResNet-50 has performed better in terms of accuracy as compared to InceptionV3 and MobileNet. As the model is deployed on microcomputer, MobileNet is best suited for the embedded device even though its accuracy is less.

articleTitle: A Review on Federated Learning approach in Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: In today's era, there is exponential increase in generation of data due to high speed internet availability, use of various electronics gadgets and IOT Use of that data for decision making has been increased proportionally. Typically, Machine Learning (ML) process has been done by collecting the data centrally on the cloud or server from each connected client nodes for training a model of machine learning which will be referred as global model. Then it is distributed and applied to all devices for generating expected throughput. The issue is that, user data is personal and confidential. As there is increase in volume, velocity and veracity of data that directly increases the concerns of data privacy. Collection of accurate data is the major concern for the classical centralized machine learning process of training and building ML prototypes with high efficiency, because in this method client must have to provide their private information to server. So here we are proposing an approach of federated learning which will be the interchange of local learning update parameters with the global learning model. Federated Learning is based on machine learning in which it trains an algorithm over multiple decentralized devices using local data, without transferring the data from client to server. The main proposition behind federated learning implementation is to bring the centralized model parameter to the connected decentralized devices and so it abolish the need of uploading user data on server. As users personal data detain on the client node itself, this helps protect data from its misuse and ensure security, as only the prototype result parameter are shared with the global model. This machine learning privacy enhancement is groundbreaking and opens up new ways for machine learning systems to handle sensitive data.

articleTitle: Implementation of Faster RCNN Algorithm for Smart Robotic ARM Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Robotic arm is a powerful mechanism used in industries to carry out pick and place tasks with great speed and accuracy. This task can either be accomplished by an arm that follows a preprogramed trajectory or an arm that can use its own intelligence to complete the task using Machine Learning. The problem with an arm which lacks intelligence is that with changing circumstances they cannot acclimatize well, the arm needs human intervention to reprogram as per requirement and perform only as per instructed. However, the intelligent robotic arm can be made capable enough to make its own decision for tasks. Some already prevailing projects in this domain are majorly based on sensors for the classification and detection of objects for pick and place tasks. The arm that uses a color-based sensor for detection majorly has a drawback that is less accurate in exact color detection of objects and detection time is also compromised and if sensors fail, the entire system will not perform the intended task. To address this problem, we propose using the Faster Region-Based Convolutional Neural Networks ML model to implement an arm capable of automatically sorting red and blue boxes by capturing their images with an OV5674 camera and processing them on a Raspberry Pi 3 B+ to accurately detect and classify red and blue boxes. The mechanical arm movement is ensured by a precise inverse kinematic model, which helps pick and segregate packets according to the color they possess. Both accuracy and real-time computing performance are good in the experimental findings of the Faster RCNN model. The precision we achieved by using the Faster RCNN model is 78.8% for detecting and sorting red and blue boxes. Hence, experimentation using Faster RCNN for smart robotic arm has successfully resulted in good outcomes.

articleTitle: Extensive Study of Automatic Text Summarization on Biomedical Texts
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Documents containing biomedical information come in a variety of formats.
