Clinical, research doctors and researchers can use biomedical literature to assess the most recent achievements in a field of study to generate and validate new theories, conduct experiments, and analyze the results. Medical records are difficult to analyze since they are normally presented in plain text, have a very particular technical language, and are almost always unstructured. Due to the ongoing increase of online text resources Document summarization offers a plethora of applications in data extraction and web search. We have done a survey of automatic text summarization techniques. Considering the existing research gaps, we have proposed a model which utilizes BERT and Group Average Linkage clustering on articles taken from PubMed. This work would be helpful for people in the biomedical domain by summarizing huge biomedical texts. It would provide a brief summary by condensing the information in a nutshell, thus saving time.

articleTitle: An Unsteady State case: Calcium Profiling based on temperature variation in Neuronal cell due to Cancer Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Calcium is the functionally most important messenger for signaling transduction in the brain. The cellular metabolism is activated and tracked by diffusion of calcium, buffering system, and cytoplasmic influxes. The excess energy after cellular metabolism gets converted to heat that raises the temperature of the cellular microenvironment. Many studies also show that treatment of cancer cells also raises the temperature of the microenvironment of neuronal cells. This increased temperature in cellular metabolism alters the calcium concentration profile in neuronal cells. This paper aims to study calcium profiling due to temperature variation in neurons due to treatment of cancer. Also, the dependency of calcium concentration based on the temperature of the cellular environment is studied. In this paper, a 1-dimensional unsteady state case along with initial and extreme values have been taken to recognize the spread of calcium in neurons. The process includes dissemination of Calcium, source, and excess buffer approximation [EBA]. The analytical solution has been developed to understand the relation between Calcium concentration and variable diffusion coefficient due to a therapeutic rise in temperature.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Privacy and Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Data analytics, also referred to as big data, is a technique for analyzing massive amounts of information in both organized and unstructured forms in order to uncover relevant patterns and trends. It is necessary to design a proper framework for the use of sensitive data, as well as assurances that sensitive data will not be breached or altered, in order to protect big data privacy. Consequently, because big da-ta systems are substantially larger in terms of both scale and velocity than regular big data systems, the privacy rules for traditional database systems do not apply to big data systems, and vice versa. The delivery of new models and algorithms to large-scale data repositories that handle developing distributed contexts such as clouds, social networks, and other similar environments is essential for data privacy preservation and data security in big data environments. The current research is aimed towards achieving this goal. As a result of the usage of data for data analysis, businesses must develop a data-sharing plan that ensures data security while also protecting individual privacy. Data sharing governance is the term used to describe this process. Because of this research, the Chain-PPDM architecture for privacy-preserving massive data sets, which makes use of block chain technology and the Inter Planetary File System, has been developed and is now in use (IPFS). For the purpose of better understanding ChainPPDM, this research adopts a data mining scenario in which a large number of people are participating in examining and detecting patterns from vast volumes of data. We used data from healthcare organizations and online food delivery firms to test and validate our method.

articleTitle: An Overview of Techniques used for Determination of State-of-Charge of Batteries
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: One of the most significant components of electric vehicles is the battery management system (BMS). It allows a Li-ion battery to run for a long time. A good BMS can detect temperature, measure voltage and current, and control safety alarms to avoid overcharging and over-discharge. On the other hand, estimating battery State-of-Charge (SOC) is one of the most challenging aspects of electric vehicle operation. Many researchers have worked on traditional battery SOC evaluation methods. 28 SOC estimate approaches are examined in this study based on their accuracy and algorithm complexity. This research might help automobile businesses and engineers find the best solution for the application's needs. Several methods like machine learning and computer intelligence are applied to create smarter BMS that meet the needs of an application.

articleTitle: A Survey of the Various Methods and Models Used to Detect Long COVID
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Long-COVID or post-COVID is a phenomenon where people who have recovered from the COVID-19, suffer persisting symptoms for more than 4 weeks after the confirmed case of COVID-19 and they can last for months. Approximately 20% of the people affected by this Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) are suffering from mid and long term effects known as the Long COVID and it can affect multiple organs in the body and this can lead to death. To date, different studies and researches have been undertaken to understand about the Long COVID and make robust estimates on the predicting factors, symptoms and also to assess the various long term effects on the patients affected by it. Based on the available research articles and the papers published in mainstream journals on Long COVID, this survey paper aims at analyzing various methods and Machine learning models used to detect and predict Long COVID, to help clinicians and researchers working on early diagnosis of Long COVID.

articleTitle: GUI based Thoracic Disease Detection using Segmented Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Deep learning has shown exciting results in the field of medical imaging. Thoracic problems can be serious, and if not detected and treated in a timely manner, they can result in death. Chest X-ray imaging is being used to diagnose numerous thoracic disorders. Generally, we required a knowledgeable and experienced radiologist to examine chest X-ray images and determine whether or not a person has certain thorax abnormalities. Everyone doesn't have the opportunity to consult an expert in a timely manner to treat chest disease because in certain circumstances, speedy diagnostics are required. As a consequence, we present an image classification and segmentation-based algorithm that would predict a specific thoracic condition and produce a mask, empowering doctors to make critical decisions. Deep Learning approaches have proven their worth in a range of contexts, outperforming many state-of-the-art models. We used the U-Net framework with ResNet as the backbone and got good results. In medical image processing and semantic segmentation, U-Net outperforms.

articleTitle: Review on Recent Research Trends and Applications in Delay Tolerant Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The Delay Tolerant Networks (DTN) transfers data or develops connectivity in isolated places or in crisis situations where no network exists. The DTN has some important features like tolerating high latency, asymmetric data rates, long queuing delays, intermittent connectivity etc. In this paper, various research challenges in DTN are reviewed, such as Priority based buffer management system, multi-node adaption system, Secure and Anonymous communication, networking in DTN etc. Here, the recent routing protocols used in DTN are also reviewed and their performance parameters are compared with other traditional routing protocols. Also, various application fields of DTN are mentioned such as, in space, aircraft, road, railways and underwater networks. DTN is also used in industrial fields, Block chain, IoT, agriculture, healthcare monitoring, and smart city, post disaster situation, wildlife DTN etc.

articleTitle: Patent Classification with Intelligent Keyword Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Nowadays, companies invest to promote innovative ideas to have the edge over its competitor. These upcoming ideas are comprehensively defined in patent documents which are readily available in the public domain. So, there is a need to analyze patent documents to achieve a strong market position, get high returns on investment, and identify new business segments. One popular method for analyzing patent documents is manually classifying each technical or scientific document into several predefined technical categories by field experts. However, this manual classification approach is expensive in terms of time, cost and it is error-prone. Also, there is a requirement for extended efforts for handling frequent data updates. In contrast, cheaper and faster operations are enabled by Artificial Intelligence techniques and can relieve the human resources burden. In this paper, we suggested an intelligent keyword extraction technique to help business professionals easily identify technologies and labels of sub-technologies involved in the patent document. In this research, we considered 35,477 patent documents from the commercial patent database. We implemented an intelligent keyword extraction technique to obtain meaningful keyword sets associated with technical information from patent documents. Later on, we trained Google's BERT (i.e., Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) keyword extraction model on textual input (title, abstract, and claims) and keyword sets from patent documents for predicting patent technology and sub-technology labels. Afterward, the performance of the proposed method is compared with K-means clustering+ TF- IDF and LDA-based topic modeling. The experimental outcomes illustrate that our proposed algorithm offers a reasonable means to classify patent documents by extracting dominant keywords from patent texts. With the proposed approach, we achieved 97.18% accuracy for patent technology identification.

articleTitle: Simplifying Privacy Agreements using Machine Reading Comprehension and Open Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Privacy Agreements are critically important from the company as well as the user's point of view. Upon surveying, we realise there are three most common issues faced by the user while trying to read their privacy agreements. First is excessive use of complex language and jargon that make it extremely difficult for the user to comprehend the agreement. The second issue is that if the user has a few questions with respect to the agreement, they are not answered directly. Lastly, there lies an absence of an agreement evaluator, that can help compare the document with the standards of the industry. We aim to alleviate this situation by proposing a three-fold technique involving Text Summarization, automated question answering and a Document Evaluator. Reading comprehension is one of the most critical abilities in human intelligence, and machine reading comprehension is one of the most popular research directions in the field of natural language processing. Machine reading is one of the key aspects to achieving artificial intelligence. The introduction of deep learning and large datasets in the recent few years has encouraged the success of MRC. Additionally, the open domain automatic question answering models have been widely studied in recent years. However, the problem of lack of sufficient data to read information from exists that makes questions out of the context of the text seem difficult to answer. In this study, we propose a novel framework to integrate MRC along with Open Domain to answer questions with increasing accuracy. This is achieved by classifying the question and retrieving the answer from multiple sources. Our model should be able to extract answers from discontinuous spans across the passage text. The answer that has the highest confidence associated with it is returned as the final answer. Moreover, the existing passage has been updated based on the questions answered.

articleTitle: Review of EDM for Analyzing the Performance of Students in Educational Setting
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Data Mining plays an importnt role in Education setor in which it extracts the useful pattern from data collected from education field. So educational data mining (EDM) is related to the use of data mining, machine learning and statistical analysis technique on education related data. EDM is used to analyze the academic performance of students, predicting the students' performance in MOOC, to identify the students” educational behavior, to predict the dropout student in online courses, etc. In this study, the systematic review of EDM is considered related to the data mining algorithms - Classification technique, Clustering technique, Association Rule Mining algorithms and other technique such as graph mining, process mining, sentiment analysis, etc. For review purpose, 49 articles from Elsevier Journal or Procedia in EDM were analysed. It is found that maximum EDM research is done by comparing various classification techniques and choosing the best among them. It is noted that accuracy is the most widely used performance metric for classification while support and confidence are the performance metric used for association rule algorithm. This study also focuses on future scope in this domain to help the researchers.

articleTitle: DeepPredict: A Deep Learning Based Investment Platform for Stocks and Mutual Funds
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The stock market trading is facilitated by stock exchanges, which can be thought of as markets that connect buyers and sellers. The prices of such stocks are based on demand and supply, the higher the demand for a stock, the higher its price goes up and vice versa. Mutual Funds are a portfolio of different stocks with different risks and returns. Stock Markets and Mutual Funds are dynamic in nature and thus, cannot be evaluated and predicted with normal methods, mainly machine learning algorithms which are much better suited to classification or simple regression problems. Also, they are constantly changing values that are directly affected by their own previous values. As such they are also affected by various external factors to varying degrees, the impact of which cannot be fixed to some values. In this paper, we proposed DeepPredict platform which predicts the stock prices and mutual fund prices for the Indian markets using LSTM as a deep learning model. Result shows that LSTM based model outperformed and gave best accuracy results and considerable RMSE value.

articleTitle: A Recommendation System for Integrated Agriculture Using Neural Networks with Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Agriculture and its affiliated sectors are significant sources of income in rural India. However, the agricultural yield per hectare is poor compared to worldwide norms. A difficulty experienced by the farmers is that the suitable crop is not selected for their soil conditions, resulting in a diminished yield. This study solves this difficulty by proposing a recommendation system with an accuracy of 96% that efficiently uses a random forest algorithm to select a crop based on site-specific variables. Plant diseases affect their unique species' growth; consequently, early detection is vital. Therefore to categorize and detect symptoms of plant illnesses, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture with an accuracy of 75% is utilized with numerous visualization techniques. Early diagnosis would aid in minimizing pesticide usage; further CNN model for the guiding of pesticides is also adopted with an overall accuracy of 81%. In addition, these strategies are evaluated using a range of performance metrics. Agriculture is an underdevelopment field lacking a solid trade mechanism to sell the harvest, resulting in farmers' benefit. An E-commerce platform has been built where farmers can sell daily generated commodities straight from their field location or their residences without adding the market—incorporating Artificial intelligence into agriculture methods has proven helpful in modernizing farming in a suggested system comprising crop, fertilizer, pesticide recommendation, and plant disease detection.

articleTitle: Examining Deep Learning Methods For The Detection Of Sepsis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Sepsis is a fatal syndrome that develops when the body reacts to an infection or virus, thereby, inducing inflammation which might result in organ dysfunction. Detecting sepsis at an earlier stage is critical, as a delay in antibiotic treatment has been reported to result in an increase in mortality rate, with a 7.6% increase in fatalities for individuals with critical sepsis condition every few hours the antibiotic administration is delayed. Hence, the earlier sepsis is detected and quicker the treatment is administered, the better the outcome for the patient and a reduced cost would have to be borne by the healthcare system. At present, there is no particular test to detect sepsis. Detection is usually done by keeping track of body temperature, heart rate etc. and conducting appropriate tests when organ failure occurs. This is not a reliable method and hence the need for better ways of detection arises. With the evolution of digital technology, Machine Learning (ML) has the ability to revolutionize medicine. Deep learning, a subset of ML, has gained immense popularity in recent times due to the ample quantity of data generated in various fields. Around 2.5 quintillion bytes of data are generated each day, according to statistics. As a result, the expansion of the world's economy is increasingly being attributed to big data. This paper presents a comparison of the classification report, accuracy and runtime of Neural Network, LSTM, and CNN on the public dataset proposed by PhysioNet Challenge 2019. The paper aims to study the effectiveness of different deep learning methods on clinical data. Data preprocessing involves handling missing values by imputation of mean, median and mode. SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique) is an oversampling method that has been incorporated to manage imbalanced data by replicating minority class entries. The paper explains the advantages of CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) that is capable of effective feature extraction and LSTM (Long short-term memory) that can assist in time series analysis and prediction. This will help estimate the theoretical resources required for performing the computation. This will provide a foundation for developing ensemble methods using these models and help understand its intricacies, advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Ontology based Disease Diagnosis using Natural Language Processing, SPARQL and Protégé from Patient Symptoms
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: As medical science is evolving; more diseases are being detected and have forayed into our world with high mortality rates. Accurate and immediate diagnosis and treatment has become extremely important. Some diseases take time to show distinctive symptoms but decline in health is extremely fast. This paper proposes a way of assisting individuals having marginalized access to healthcare and aims to decrease the ever-growing pressure on doctors. We aim to develop a model that will be able to give a classification of the disease that the patient might be suffering from after inputting the patient's symptoms in English or their native language using voice commands or text. Ontology has been created on the software Protégé, which contains information of about 13000 diseases out of which almost 5000 are infectious. Here, the causal insights will provide the various relationships between symptoms, symptom hierarchies, diseases and disease super classes. While this information might not be useful for the patient, the same will assist the doctor in providing faster treatment. Hence, this model can also be used by doctors for reconfirmation of their diagnosis and to revalidate the treatment being provided after generating the knowledge graph.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Recommendation Engines
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Big Data (BD) is consistently participating in the recent computing revolution in an immense way. The volume of data generated through online platforms such as e-commerce portals comprises of huge hidden information which needs to be analyzed in-order to better serve customer's needs and retain their loyalty. Various Recommendation Engines (RE) have been proposed to tackle this problem and generate optimal recommendations based on user needs. This paper reviews and compares various types of RE highlighting their techniques, issues, applications, advantages and disadvantages. The paper also presents some results for different types of RE using sample datasets (Movie lens 100K) [12].

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Brain Disease Diagnosis Using Rotation Invariant Features and Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The characteristic features of the magnetic resonant image (MRI) for Alzheimer's patient's brain image and normal image can be distinguished in terms of dimensional features with the help of wavelet decomposition. From the literature review, it is observed that when datasets used are a combination of the MR images having a very mild cognitive impairment and mild cognitive impairment, the performance of the classifier reduces. Because the features of this kind of MR image are difficult to distinguish from normal brain images. To solve this problem, the lossless feature extraction method along with the feature reduction method having a selection approach is suggested as a solution here. In this paper, the 12 directional, rotation invariant two-dimensional discrete-time continuous wavelet transform (R-DTCWT) and a genetic algorithm (GA) are used for feature selection and feature vector size reduction. The fuzzy neural network (FNN) which is suitable for pattern recognition is used here. The FNN with and without feature reduction is evaluated for identification of combinational dataset, shows satisfactory performance over an artificial neural network (ANN), probabilistic neural network (PNN) classifiers. This method is compared with other state of algorithm to prove the enhanced performance

articleTitle: An Automated System for Rural People Complaint Handling, Monitoring and Analysis using Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: In this paper, we attempted to explain the disconnect between rural citizens and their local authorities in terms of the common difficulties they encounter. Rural residents face challenges, and the government has resources to address them, but there is no link between the two. We have developed an automated system for handling, monitoring, and assessing rural inhabitants' concerns and assisting them in resolving these complaints as quickly as possible, resulting in the growth of such regions. We intend to collect and create a text dataset of rural people's concerns in classify them using a machine learning model. We have created a user-friendly dashboard for administrators to monitor, handle, and analyse complaints by region, date, kind, and other criteria. Throughout the complaint life-cycle, the user is kept up to date on the status of the issue, ensuring that problems are resolved. The system is transparent because administrators can use this data as proof of work during elections, allowing end-users, i.e. rural residents, to choose the proper leaders for their region who will not only listen to their issues but also handle them in a reasonable timeframe.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of the Indian Financial Market
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is a natural language processing (NLP) technique which is used to interpret the emotional tonality of a text. The purpose of the research was to analyze how a negative or positive statement could influence the position of a company in the financial market. For the above reason, a dataset of around 25000 tweets was scrapped using the Tweepy library following by data cleaning using Regex. The data was then allotted a positive or negative sentiment using the flair package. Finally, using the tensor flow package, the data was tokenized and applied to the proposed GRU model. Different metrics such as accuracy, recall, precision, f1 have been used to determine the outcomes and results of the conducted research. In contribution, a unique twitter dataset was created that is based solely on Indian financial market and can be further used for financial research and analysis.

articleTitle: Detection of Lung Cancer Pulmonary Nodules Using Computer Aided Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Lung cancer is one type of serious disorders of the globe. Compared to other forms of cancer in both males and females, lung cancer records the highest number of cancer-related deaths. Pulmonary nodules are blob-like shapes that are between 3 mm and 30 mm in diameter. Lung cancer can reveal itself in the form of pulmonary nodules. Number of surveys indicate that testing of lung cancer can significantly decrease the death rate. For the purpose of determining the presence of lung cancer and successive schedule of supervision, correct examination of pulmonary nodules is necessary. For the study of lung CT pictures, novice radiologists rely on professional specialists. For such a conventional learning system, the shortage of time from professional radiologists is the key bottleneck. Hence, there is a need for the design of an Automatic Computer Aided Detection system (CAD) tool to support radiologists and analysis of lung cancer.

articleTitle: Discovering the Location by Intelligent Chatbot Support using NLP
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Discovering the person location through a chatbot within the geographical virtual barrier boundary i.e., called Geofence that allows users to detect when someone enters or departs a location. Geofence main motive is for finding the person in a specific area rather than the entire map area. The polygonal geofence is a type of geofence that helps us to cover precisely the boundaries of a building that we want to cover. The coordinates of a building, i.e., the Latitude and Longitude, can be used to generate a polygonal geofence that covers only that area of the building. Although a circular geofence can be utilized, it will cover an undesirable area, which is why a polygonal geofence is preferable. With the assist of GPS/Wi-Fi technology to track a person's location, geofence will cover the necessary geographical virtual barrier borders, and a chatbot will provide the person's location anytime humans ask it. GPS can send location data to the chatbot whether the person is inside the virtual boundary; otherwise, it will indicate that the person is not in that zone. Similarly, Wi-Fi will assist in tracking the location of people inside the building per floor. The chatbot will assist in determining a person's location so that we can determine exactly where the person is standing. The chatbot is a text-based input system that allows us to communicate as if we were chatting with a human. Natural language understanding and Natural Language Generation are used in Natural Language processing the key objective is that any student who desires to meet with a specific teacher to rectify any doubts or submit work can employ this intelligent chatbot to discover the teacher's current position.

articleTitle: Weak Supervision as an efficient approach for Automated Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The real-life applications of machine learning and artificial intelligence has expanded in huge amounts in the past few years. Owing to the rapid developments and advances in various machine learning and deep learning models, developers are now able to achieve futuristic accuracy on standard datasets without any need of manually devised features. However, there is a big obstacle: these models are hungry for data and require large amount of labeled data which ultimately depend on immense human efforts for labeling. The complexity of deep learning models is very high as compared to many of the conventional deep learning models and contain large number of parameters and computations. As a result, these models require large training data to suffice efficient learning. The task of labeling such huge training sets manually is very costly and equally time-consuming. Creating any standard/benchmark dataset might take months or years and may require domain expertise. Also, such dataset which is hand-labeled is difficult to modify and restructure for new purposes. Due to all the above-stated reasons, various types of weak/noisy supervision techniques are being explored and used by developers and scientists, such as using heuristics for labeling training data with the help of external knowledge bases and meta information, patterns/rules, or other CV based classifiers. This paper begins by discussing techniques in machine learning that address the problem of manual-labeling of training data, and then describe our research on modeling, developing, and integrating a varied set of weak supervision sources for labeling unlabeled data obtained from production plants for the automated optical inspection task. In this research, a rivets dataset is used which consists of 4,56,100 images of defective and non-defective magnetic rivets of a control panel with very less labeled data (39,466 images). The dataset consists of images of three batches collected over different time intervals and hence, images across batches have different contrast and luminous intensities. Also, the batches have different amount of class imbalance. We have developed a weak supervised learning pipeline containing weak-supervision sources to obtain weak labels for the unlabeled data and used various consensus strategies to obtain final weaklabels. Later, we trained a CNN model with the weak labels as final labels and compared the results with the model trained with only labeled data.

articleTitle: Calibration, Recalibration and Self- Calibration of a Hybrib Stereo Camera System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA

authors.preferredName: Muhammad Izzul Azri Bin Zainol Azman

abstract: Nowadays, the risen number of losses of hearing and loss of eyesight has become alarming to all doctors and researchers to speed up the finding on how to tackle the problems that occur. The difficulty of transporting the drug through the inner ear and indirect visualization of the surgical targets has become the reason for the risen number of lost hearing and lost eyesight. The risk of the inaccuracy of delivering the drug to the targeted place as the cochlea which is the part of the inner ear organ has led us to conduct this research study. While for retinal surgery, the need for direct visualization of the surgical targets and tactile feedback has also become the factor that this study is focusing on overcoming the need for that. This study is focusing on overcoming the criteria needed for the drug transporting in the inner ear and the retinal surgery by having the accuracy for the drug transportation and with the stereo vision that we are proposing can tackle the visualization problem of the surgical target and the tactile feedback. This study is validated by having a real-time scenario of the estimation rigid transformation between the controller of the drug delivery and the ability to update the location of the drug throughout the delivery process.

articleTitle: Online Hate Classifier For Social Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: The surge in social media platforms accredits users to reveal their opinions widely. With this boost in social media usage, the impartation between users becomes divergent because of diversity in educational backgrounds, culture, country, etc. Its consequences may take the form of clashes among the people, contaminating online environments. This content that inculcates hate among the people is termed Hate Speech. Such speech comprises various aggressive, violent, offensive language to target a specific crowd sharing common ideas, philosophy, region, religion, culture, etc. To address this concern, we developed an application that detects whether a given content (text, image) contains hate messages or not. For that, we have used a dataset that contained a total of 24783 comments from Twitter platform with 77.43% of the comments tagged as offensive language and 17% of the comments tagged as hate language. We then experimented with various models like logistic regression, random forest classifier, etc. and we got the best f1 score of 0.97 for the KNN (K-Nearest Neighbour) algorithm, hence we have deployed the final outcome with the KNN algorithm.

articleTitle: Machine learning application for Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Lung diseases are a major concern nowadays. The human body consists of diverse fundamental organs, out of which Lung is one of them. The Lungs are made up of two sections, right lung and left lung and the main function of lungs is to facilitate exchange of gas which is called as breathing or respiration. Our present modern lifestyle, ecological contamination, adulteration is helping in expanding the Human Lungs issue. What's more, simultaneously there are various Image processing techniques that are blending the tremendous answer for the medical field to identify and analyze the Lung's illnesses. A system development which is based on Deep learning is proposed to get better and accurate result which includes Image Processing techniques like image pre-processing, segmentation, thresholding, image enhancement and classification. Computer Tomography (CT) scan images takes from LIDC database as an input to examine the Lungs disorders in human body. Convolution Neural Network is practiced to perform classification of input lung images into cancerous and noncancerous classes. This technique will assist to oncologists as second opinion and will develop the accurate quality of lung cancer detection. With the proposed system, lung cancer detection is done with 98.44% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Stalker Ads: A study to Understand the Consumer Awareness and Perception towards Targeted Advertising
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Advertisers today give personalized ad messages for each customer based on personal information to break out of the congested ad environment. They use this targeting strategy to improve the efficiency of their ads, but it also raises information security and privacy concerns as consumers are often unaware of the practices that lead to the functioning of these advertisements. Apart from this, consumer interest and the credibility of the advertisement content also play a vital role in deducing a consumer perception. The current study uses an online questionnaire-based survey to look at the impact on the effectiveness of the targeted advertisement based on consumer perception, which is derived from multiple factors like consumer interest, content credibility, security concern and awareness, and value delivery. It is observed that consumer awareness causes privacy concerns, which leads to a decrease in the value delivery of these ads. On the other hand, it is also observed that content credibility hardly affects value delivery. Moreover, the findings indicated that the value delivery from these targeted advertisements has a significant positive impact on consumer perception, which ultimately relates to the overall effectiveness of these targeted advertisements. The study adds to the theoretical understanding of the factors that impact customer perceptions of targeted advertising. Also, the analysis and findings from this study will help the advertisers understand the consumer concerns related to these targeted ads and guide them to take the required efforts to gain consumer trust and improve the overall transparency and efficiency of the targeted advertisements.

articleTitle: Real-Time Voice Enabled Drivers' Safety Monitoring System Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Accidents and road crashes occurring due to dissociation of driver from his consciousness is one of the hot topics researchers have been contemplating to curtail, from the past few years. This dissociation wanes the driver's ability to concentrate on the road while driving and promotes occurrence of mishaps. There has been a challenge to non-intrusively detect drowsiness and fatigue-level of drivers in real-time environments and concomitantly make it computationally faster and less complex. The paper proposes a faster real-time driver inactiveness detection system capable of alerting drivers of their drowsiness by inspecting and scrutinizing the state of eyes and mouth and follows a non-obtrusive approach. The system utilizes eyes to monitor the drooping nature of eyes and examines the mouth's current state to detect any yawning activity performed. Initially, it uses Haar transform to extract facial features and strong classifiers for detecting faces by incorporating Adaboost algorithm. Next, shape predictors are used to locate the key points for obtaining position of mouth and eyes within the face area. States of the mouth and eyes are continuously monitored with the help of the metrics viz. Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) and Mouth Yawn Width respectively and are used to alert the driver through voice-enabled commands followed by a warning alarm sound to trigger them thereby aiding in regaining their consciousness back and focusing on their driving. The algorithm used in this system is tested under different lighting conditions and against different possible situations and accurate results in terms of successful detection rates are obtained.

articleTitle: A Methods of Medical Image Security Using Visual-Cryptography Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Today in this technology era, most of the information is exchanged across open channels, and the security of such information has been a major concern. Medical Image Security has emerged as a new modern study subject as a result of the development of digital health-care data systems. To address medical picture security, the majority of researchers have employed image watermarking and image encryption. Though there are various other methods are also used for securing information in digital images such as steganography, digital signing, the Visual cryptography techniques is still popular among researcher for information security. The Visual Cryptography Scheme has the unique virtue of being able to decode visually the secure image by superimposing shares without the need for computation. The public key encryption approach is also used to make the visual cryptography image sharing more safe. In this article we carried the review of all these information hiding methods, types and technologies available in the literature along with their need and challenges for implementation.

articleTitle: Customized YOLOv3 model for face detection in crowded images
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference On Computing, Communication, Control And Automation (ICCUBEA
abstract: Face detection (FD) is an essential stage in many applications like face recognition, object detection, and class attendance systems. The accuracy of the FD system affects the further processing stages in those applications. Therefore, the reliable FD system should give all faces that exist in the input image, and the corresponding bounding boxes as well. The standard methods for the FD system work well for frontal faces. However, those methods have a low accuracy where faces are blocked, blurred, or different in scales. In this work, hyper-parameters of the you-only-look-once version 3 (YOLOv3) algorithm are customized and used for FD in crowded images. Firstly, the dimensions of the anchor boxes is fine-tuned to be more appropriate to detect different face scales in crowded images. This customization gives better performance for YOLOv3 comparing with the predefined anchor boxes in this algorithm. Secondly, the dimensions of features on the last detection layers are reduced to enhance the detection speed. Finally, the proposed model is compared with other vision-based and deep learning-based FD algorithms using real-life crowded images. The conducted experiments on the Google open images v4 dataset show that accuracy of the customized YOLOv3 is 94.2% which outperforms the other models.
